criteria.requirement: Six complete locally bundled trip entries cover at least four continents with dates, photos/alt text, diary content and coordinates.
criteria.action: Inspect the six bundled trip entries and their photos, dates and location information.
criteria.expected: At least four continents are represented with complete diary content, coordinates and meaningful photo alt text.

criteria.requirement: Geographically correct globe markers and list selection open the same trip and highlight it.
criteria.action: Select the same trip from a globe marker and the list.
criteria.expected: Both open the same entry and highlight its geographically correct globe position.

criteria.requirement: Far-side markers cannot be clicked through the globe, and close markers remain independently selectable.
criteria.action: Try selecting far-side markers and nearby marker groups.
criteria.expected: The globe occludes far-side markers and nearby trips remain independently selectable.

criteria.requirement: Search/year filters, chronological view and useful empty states work; reset-view preserves active filters.
criteria.action: Combine search/year filters, inspect chronological order and empty results, then reset the view.
criteria.expected: Filters and ordering work, empty results explain the state, and reset changes the view without clearing filters.

criteria.requirement: Trip URLs survive refresh and browser back returns coherent journal context.
criteria.action: Open a trip URL directly, refresh and use browser back.
criteria.expected: Trip URLs restore the intended entry and browser history maintains coherent journal context.

criteria.requirement: Keyboard list access, ordinary mobile page scrolling and reduced-motion camera transitions remain usable.
criteria.action: Reach trips through the keyboard list, scroll on a phone and enable reduced motion.
criteria.expected: All trips remain reachable, page scrolling is not trapped and camera transitions respect reduced motion.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the globe geography, local photos and six-trip list.
Select trips from both list and markers, inspect nearby markers and try clicking a far-side location after changing view.
Filter by year/search, inspect empty/chronological states, reset the camera without clearing filters, then refresh and go back from a shared trip URL.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
